task: There is RNA-seq 10X Cell Ranger data and BCR-seq data (use the filtered contig annotations) from 6 patients. You can find metadata related to the patients in the metadata.csv file. For each patient, two measurements were taken: one before influenza vaccination (e.g. 09-0) and the other 7 days after the vaccination (e.g. 09-7). Use only cells that have both RNA-seq and BCR-seq data at every step of the analysis. Before applying any quality filtering, output the total number of cells that have both RNA-seq and BCR-seq data across all patients. Perform basic data pre-processing. Filter out cells with mitochondrial RNA content greater or equal 10%. Keep only cells with exactly one productive heavy chain and one productive light chain. Perform the PCA analysis. Do you see a patient that stands out from the rest? Output their patient id or 'None'. Which two patients have the largest clonotypes (in number of cells, defined across all samples)? What is the heavy-chain junction amino-acid sequence (including the conserved C and W) of the largest clonotype? In what condition is clonal expansion (>=2 cells) greater? Output one of: 'pre-vaccination' or 'post-vaccination'. For young patients, what is the ratio of post-vaccination to pre-vaccination clonal expansion?
